review_candidates.title: Software Project Head
review_candidates.description: Company Description elämä.ai is a technology company focused on creating human-centric digital solutions that positively impact everyday life and support a better future. The team combines advanced software engineering with thoughtful design to build products that are both intelligent and intuitive. At elämä.ai, collaboration, innovation, and ethical use of technology are core values that guide product development and business decisions. Joining the company means contributing to impactful projects in a dynamic environment where new ideas are encouraged and continuous learning is supported. Role Description The Software Project Head is a full-time, on-site leadership role based in Heliopolis. This role oversees the end-to-end delivery of software projects, including planning, requirements gathering, project scoping, and defining milestones and timelines. The Software Project Head coordinates cross-functional teams, manages resources, and ensures alignment between technical execution and business objectives. Day-to-day responsibilities include leading project meetings, tracking progress, resolving risks and dependencies, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders. The role also involves mentoring team members, enforcing quality standards, and continuously improving processes to deliver reliable, scalable, and maintainable software solutions. Qualifications Strong project management skills, including planning, scheduling, risk management, and stakeholder communication. Solid background in software development practices, SDLC, and modern engineering methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or similar). Experience leading cross-functional technical teams and coordinating work across engineering, product, and QA. Ability to translate business needs into clear technical requirements, user stories, and prioritized backlogs. Proficiency with project and collaboration tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Confluence, or equivalent) and basic understanding of version control systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-informed decisions under time constraints. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degrees or relevant certifications (e.g., PMP, Scrum Master) are an advantage. Previous experience in a similar leadership role in software projects or product development environments. Demonstrated ability to work on-site in a collaborative setting, foster an inclusive team culture, and support professional growth of team members.

review_candidates.title: Project engineer - HV
review_candidates.description: Project engineer - HV (Primary Plant) Cairo, Egypt At Scatec, you get to work on something that matters. We develop, build, own, and operate renewable energy solutions that accelerate access to reliable and affordable clean energy. As part of a global and agile organisation, you will work with skilled colleagues across functions and geographies, take real ownership, and contribute to a company driven by the vision of improving our future. At the heart of everything we do is our belief that we bring the energy - the energy for change, connection, and growth. It shapes how we collaborate, innovate, and create impact together. If you are looking for a role where your contribution is visible, your development matters, and your work supports a more sustainable future, Scatec may be the right place for you. Ready to make an impact? Why this role matters This role supports and leads the design of technically compliant MV and HV interconnection projects, with a strong focus on primary plant, HV/MV equipment, and substation design. You will help ensure technical and contractual requirements are reflected in project solutions, supporting development, execution, and operations through sound engineering assessments, due diligence, stakeholder engagement, and design reviews. What you’ll be doing In this role, you will: Support and review interconnection solutions based on project, utility, and grid requirements. Develop technical base cases, specifications, and design inputs for interconnection works. Coordinate and review primary plant system design packages, including outsourced detailed designs. Review technical documentation, contracts, grid codes, and connection agreements to define project requirements. Support supplier evaluations, RFP documentation, and technical schedules for key project contracts. Review substation, transmission line, earthing, equipment selection, fire protection, cable sizing, lightning protection, and related interfaces. Support execution teams through design alignment, site visits, testing, commissioning, energisation, and project close-out. Provide technical support to operations by investigating issues and improving relevant operational systems. Your work will support real decisions, real assets, and real operational outcomes. What you’ll gain Professional growth through ownership, exposure, and meaningful contribution from day one. Hands-on experience in a role where the challenge is energising, fast-moving, meaningful, and built on learning through doing. Exposure to complex renewable energy interconnection projects across development, execution, and operations. The opportunity to work closely with engineering, project, supply chain, contractors, utilities, and operations teams across geographies. What you’ll bring Experience And Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical or Electronic Engineering. Minimum 4 years of electrical engineering experience, including experience in a project environment. Experience in distribution, reticulation, HV/MV equipment, substation design, or transmission line design. Strong understanding of renewable energy project interconnection design and execution. Sound knowledge of utility interfaces, grid requirements, and contracts related to energy generation projects. Proficiency in MS Office; experience with AutoCAD, PowerFactory DigSilent, ETAP, or PSCAD is advantageous. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Independent, analytical, proactive, and comfortable working across functions, stakeholders, and cultures. Willing and able to travel internationally, work extended hours when required, and support site-based activities in varied conditions. What it’s like to work at Scatec At Scatec, we combine purpose with performance. We value responsibility, clarity, and collaboration and we encourage people to challenge existing ways of working, contribute ideas, and keep developing. You can expect an environment where people work together across disciplines and geographies, where good performance matters, and where you are trusted to take ownership without unnecessary hierarchy. If you are motivated by engineering excellence, renewable energy impact, and the chance to shape reliable grid interconnection solutions, this could be a strong next step in your career. What we offer At Scatec, you will be part of a company with a clear and ambitious purpose, working on renewable energy solutions that make a lasting difference. You will gain responsibility early, learn from experienced colleagues, and build your capabilities in a business that offers global exposure, strong development opportunities, and meaningful work in the energy transition. We are continuously evolving as a digital and data-driven organisation, leveraging technology and AI to improve how we work and create value for our teams Scatec is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, competence, and business needs. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

review_candidates.title: Human Resources Business Partner
review_candidates.description: Company Description El Ezaby Pharmacy is Egypt’s leading provider of health and personal care products, with a legacy that began in 1975 and has grown into a major healthcare corporation. The group operates a nationwide network of over 450 branches and multiple warehouses, serving communities across the country. El Ezaby Pharmacy is known for pioneering operational models and offering services such as home delivery, patient consultation, and health awareness initiatives. The organization invests heavily in a dedicated development center, where highly qualified professionals train team members to meet global standards. Team members join a culture that emphasizes continuous learning, professional growth, and trusted, patient-centered service. Role Description The Human Resources Business Partner is a full-time, on-site role based in Qesm 1st Nasser City. This role partners with business leaders to understand workforce needs, support organizational objectives, and implement HR strategies that enhance employee engagement and performance. Day-to-day responsibilities include advising managers on HR policies, overseeing employee relations cases, and ensuring compliance with labor and employment laws. The HR Business Partner will manage performance management processes, support talent development initiatives, and contribute to workforce planning and organizational change projects. This role also involves collaborating closely with HR colleagues on recruitment, onboarding, and retention initiatives, while promoting a positive, inclusive workplace culture. Qualifications Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Policies, including experience designing, communicating, and implementing HR programs. Proficiency in Employee Relations, with the ability to handle employee concerns, support conflict resolution, and foster a respectful work environment. Knowledge of Labor and Employment Law, with practical experience ensuring compliance and mitigating HR-related risks. Experience in Performance Management, including setting objectives, conducting evaluations, and supporting development plans. Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; HR certifications are an advantage. Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with leaders and team members. Analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using HR data and metrics to inform decisions. Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, multi-site or retail/healthcare environment is preferred.

review_candidates.description: Company Description مكتب تصميمات معمارية وديكورات is a specialized architectural and interior design studio based in New Cairo. The firm focuses on delivering creative, functional, and aesthetically balanced designs for residential, commercial, and mixed-use projects. The Architectural Designer is expected to participate in client meetings and contribute creative ideas that align with project budgets and timelines. Proficiency in Construction Drawings and technical detailing, including preparing coordinated plans, sections, and elevations. Skilled in Drawing and visual representation, using both hand sketching and digital tools for design development and presentations. Basic understanding or interest in Urban Planning and its impact on site layout and project context. Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or a closely related field. Proficiency in relevant design and drafting software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit,3D max, or similar 2D/3D tools) Ability to work on-site in New Cairo, collaborate within a team, and manage multiple tasks with attention to detail. Knowledge of local building codes and construction practices is an advantage. Strong communication skills and willingness to engage with clients and project stakeholders.
